name: FLUX 3 Max
summary: Turn a text prompt or starting image into a 5–20 second 720p video with native audio, with a 10-second clip rendering in about 12 seconds. Use it on fal at a $2.55-per-minute launch price for three weeks, then $10.20.

name: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017
summary: Run a cheap open-weight coding and agent model with a 1M-token context, MIT-licensed on Hugging Face or via the API at $0.15/$0.60 per million tokens. A new Search API adds web search for $0.75 per 1,000 requests.

name: ChatGPT for Chrome tab control
summary: Let ChatGPT read across your open Chrome tabs or, in Work mode, take them over to fill forms, send messages, and download files. Install the extension and tag @Chrome in a ChatGPT Work or Codex chat.

name: Muse Spark Open
summary: Run an open-weight coding and agent model with a 1M-token context through OpenRouter, Groq, or Together, or download the weights from Hugging Face. Running it locally takes about 1 TB of memory, such as two M5 Ultra Mac Studios.

name: Gemini 4 Argon
summary: Hand long coding and research jobs to a frontier model that can write up to 1M tokens of output. Use it through the paid Gemini API at an introductory $2/$10 per million tokens through November 30, or in the Gemini app on Pro and Ultra.

name: Personal apps on Google Play
summary: Describe an Android app in AI Studio and install it on your own phone through Google Play, with no developer account or $25 fee. It's US-only for adults for now, with private sharing to friends coming later.

name: Drama 3
summary: Direct AI voiceovers in plain language, shifting emotion mid-sentence or within a single word across 83 languages. Use it in the web app or API at a $10 per million characters launch price through November 12, or download the open weights.

name: Claude Docs, Slides, and Design
summary: Create documents, slide decks, and designs directly in a Claude conversation, now on every plan including Free. Edit them on your phone and export decks to PowerPoint, PDF, or editable Google Slides.
